protocol.families_note: columns shown for h=1; per-horizon columns carry the _{h}m suffix
protocol.models: per-fold StandardScaler + L2 logistic C=1 (direction) / ridge alpha=1 (volatility)
protocol.decision_rule: >=9/16 improving AND >=9/16 improving with p < alpha (train._ablation_summary)
protocol.design: one-shot frozen holdout; every arm fitted once on all dev hourly complete-case rows whose targets finish before the holdout start, then scored on every minute of the primary window (decisive) and of the full holdout window (secondary, descriptive); direct readouts fit nothing
